The idea of a “safe job” is slowly disappearing. As AI begins to reshape industries, career disruptions may become more common than most people expect. Yet many financial plans are still built on the assumption of a stable 30-year career.
In this video, Karthik Rangappa explores how individuals should rethink their financial planning in a world where job security cannot be taken for granted. He shares a few practical ideas that can help make your finances more resilient in the face of uncertainty.
